name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 23, 2015
6:00 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
INVOCATION - Pastor Tom Straeter, Grace Presbyterian Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of the 2015 Law Enforcement Awards as follows: Carlos Canela, Sworn Officer of the Year; Darcie Brown, Professional Staff Member of the Year; and Everett Draper, Senior Volunteer Patrol.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD/SA/JPFA)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending March 31, 2015 (CC)
C4.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending April 30, 2015 (CC)
C5.
Fee Waiver for Operation HOPE at 859 E. Vista Way (CC)
C6.
Replacement of Wave Waterpark Water Heater (CC)
C7.
CIP No. 8238 Park Improvements Projects Agreement for the Installation of Synthetic Turf
at the Moonlight Amphitheatre (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving an agreement with EasyTurf, Inc.; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , amending the FY 2014/15 Capital Improvement Program Budget.
C8.
CIP No. 8279 Vista Safe Routes to School Master Plan Engineering Award of Contract (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving an agreement with KOA Corporation; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , amending the FY 2015/16 Capital Improvement Program Budget.
C9.
CIP No. 8207 Sewer Pipeline Rehabilitation Phase II Award of Contract (BSD)
C10.
CIP No. 8245 & 8259 Buena Creek Pump Station Repairs Award of Contract (BSD)
C11.
CIP Nos. 8272/8273/8275 Engineering Design and Rehabilitation Studies Agreement Award for Buena Vista Pump Station, Raceway Pump Station and Buena Creek Pump Station (CC)
C12.
CIP No. 8247 Design/Build Agreement Award for Buena Vista Creek and Trail Restoration Project (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving an agreement with Orion Construction Corporation; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , amending the FY 2015/16 Capital Improvement Program Budget.
C13.
CIP No. 8270 Traffic Signal Interconnect & Upgrade Engineering Agreement Award (CC)
C14.
CalRecycle Oil Payment Program 5 Grant Award (CC)
C15.
Fiscal Year 2014/2015 Citizens' Option for Public Safety Grant Program Allocation (CC)
C16.
2015 Justice Assistance Grant (CC)
C17.
Housing-Related Parks Grant Award (CC)
C18.
Delegating Investment Authority to the City Treasurer for Fiscal Year 2015/16 and Re-
Adopting City Council Policy 700-07, Investment of City Funds (CC)
C19.
Encina Wastewater Authority Budget for Fiscal Year 2015/16 (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2015- ; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2015- .
C20.
Agreement for Weed Abatement and Waste Removal Services (CC)
C21.
Agreements for Park Playground Improvements (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2015- , approving an agreement with Zasueta Contracting, Inc., for playground preparatory work and the installation of shade sails at selected playground sites.
2.
Resolution No. 2015- , approving an agreement with Dave Bang Associates, Inc., for the purchase of shade sails and the purchase and installation of rubber surfacing at selected playground sites.
3.
Resolution No. 2015- , amending the FY 2014/15 Operating and Capital Improvement Program Budgets.
C22.
Appointments to Various Commissions, Boards and Committees (CC)
1.
Confirm the Mayor's annual appointments to various commissions, boards, and committees; and
2.
Appoint two members recommended by the Mayor to the Planning Commission.
C23.
City Council Policy 200-04, City Council Meetings (CC)
C24.
Sale of City Property (CC)
C25.
Civic Center Lease (CC)
C26.
Agreement for Park Landscape Maintenance Services (CC)
C27.
North County Transit District (NCTD) Lease (CDC)
C28.
Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan Amendments (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , amending the Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan and repealing all resolutions in conflict herewith.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , amending the City-Wide Classification and Compensation Index, and repealing all resolutions in conflict herewith.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Collection of Delinquent 2014 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public testimony; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving and confirming a report and account for abatement of weeds, shrubs, dead trees and waste matter for FY 2014/15, and ordering the assessment of unpaid charges.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
